name: OMX
description: Non-custodial Hyperliquid execution for AI agents: mandate checks, unsigned orders, verifiable receipts

skills.name: Pre-trade quote
skills.description: Quantitative comparison of execution styles (market, limit, TWAP, POV, chase) for one order: expected cost in bps, fill probability, time to fill, and an omx_intent ready for OMX. No direction or profit advice.

skills.name: Mandate check
skills.description: Evaluate an Agent Trading Mandate (atm/0) against one order and return each control's decision.

skills.name: Build unsigned order
skills.description: Mandate check, then an unsigned Hyperliquid order with a disclosed builder fee and expiresAfter, plus the EIP-712 typed data the agent's own wallet signs.

skills.name: Assemble signed order
skills.description: Assemble the Hyperliquid /exchange payload from the agent's signature and check the signer.
